name: The Fall of Ameth'Aran
summary: Sentinel Tysha Moonblade tasks adventurers with exploring the haunting ruins of Ameth'Aran in Darkshore to decipher ancient stone tablets. These inscriptions record the tragedy and ruin that struck the Highborne city during the Sundering. The gathered knowledge is intended for the Circle of Ancients in Auberdine, recovering history largely lost during the War of the Ancients.

sections.title: Echoes of the Highborne
sections.body: Long before the coast fractured into the misty expanse of Darkshore, Ameth'Aran stood as a flourishing settlement where Queen Azshara's elite sorcerers practiced powerful arcane magic. Following the cataclysmic destruction of the Well of Eternity ten thousand years ago, the city was reduced to broken marble and cracked pillars. Today, it remains haunted by the restless, anguished spirits of the Highborne who died when their golden age tore apart.

sections.title: Uncovering Lost Chronicles
sections.body: Because the War of the Ancients plunged the night elf civilization into chaotic survival, remarkably few written accounts survived the Great Sundering intact. Sentinel Tysha Moonblade attempted to survey the ruins herself, discovering two large engraved tablets—the Lay of Ameth'Aran and the Fall of Ameth'Aran—before ghostly Highborne specters forced her to retreat. Retrieving these readings ensures that the historical truths of the ancient disaster reach the scholars of the Circle of Ancients in Auberdine.

faq.answer: Ameth'Aran is an ancient night elf ruin located in central Darkshore. Ten thousand years ago, it was a city where Queen Azshara's Highborne nobility openly wielded and studied grand arcane magic before it fell during the Great Sundering.

faq.q: Why are there ghosts in Ameth'Aran?
aliases: why are there spirits in ameth aran
faq.answer: The restless ghosts haunting the ruins are the spirits of the Highborne who lived and died there. Caught in the sudden, violent catastrophe that shattered the Well of Eternity and fragmented Kalimdor, their spirits remain bound to the ruins in eternal torment.

aliases: who gives fall of ameth aran
faq.answer: Sentinel Tysha Moonblade is a night elf sentinel stationed along the road in Darkshore. She was tasked with scouting ancient sites and recovering lost historical records for the Circle of Ancients in Auberdine.

faq.q: Why does the Circle of Ancients want these tablets read?
faq.answer: The destruction of the Well of Eternity plunged Kalimdor into immense upheaval, obliterating countless libraries and monuments. Because so few written records survived the War of the Ancients, the tablets provide rare firsthand accounts of the Sundering from the perspective of the Highborne.

aliases: where are the ameth aran tablets
faq.answer: The two large tablets—the Lay of Ameth'Aran and the Fall of Ameth'Aran—are etched into standing stone monuments nestled among the ruined courtyards of Ameth'Aran, surrounded by the wandering ghosts of the city's former residents.

faq.q: What happened to the Highborne of Ameth'Aran during the Sundering?
faq.answer: When the Well of Eternity imploded at the climax of the War of the Ancients, massive tremors and arcane backlash tore Kalimdor apart. Ameth'Aran collapsed in the ruin, burying its citizens and leaving their ghosts lingering in the rubble.

angles.text: The ruins of Ameth'Aran are a grim reminder of your ancestors' hubris under Queen Azshara and the catastrophic consequences of unregulated arcane sorcery.
The tablets offer a sobering glimpse into the heights of pre-Sundering elven spellcraft and the terrible ruin brought on when that power spiraled out of control.
Aiding the Sentinels in securing the history of Darkshore helps preserve crucial lore for the night elf leaders guiding the Alliance on Kalimdor.
